rulesTestNames: lists door rows and journal entries for one covered function
read: get and list (query naming programId and functionId) where a door duty covers the function, and the programme owner, while not deleted
write: server only; written from programFunctionGuests, programGuests, programHouseholds and programFunctions
migrationNotes: Display name, RSVP and attendance state, party size, household label and response note only; never a phone number, email or other contact field. An allGuests function has a row for every programme guest. The program-door-views copy-forward migration creates views for sources that predate the triggers and leaves views the triggers wrote alone.
Guest and household anonymization reaches the rows through their source triggers.
